user.title: Connect Mój TAURON
user.description: Enter your Mój TAURON credentials. We verify login only and save them in Home Assistant. Enable consumption history separately in integration options.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Mój TAURON
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for the existing account. MFA or CAPTCHA requires attention outside this integration.

error.portal_changed: The portal response is not supported. No complete invoice scan was obtained.
error.interactive_login: The portal requires an interactive login step (for example MFA).
error.portal_login: The login response or redirect was not recognized. Check the integration version; this does not mean your password is wrong.
error.portal_archive: The archive page or its account data could not be read. Login success has not been confirmed.
error.portal_documents: The invoice list response was not recognized or was incomplete. No documents were accepted from this scan.
error.portal_history: History or the selected consumption point was not recognized. Previously confirmed data is retained.

document_check_failed.message: Could not read documents. Check the integration check status. Login credentials remain saved.

history_not_configured.message: Enable history and select your home in integration options.

history_check_failed.message: Could not refresh consumption history. Check the history status. Previous data is retained.

init.title: Consumption history
init.description: Select your home point. Import from 2024, then refresh on the first day of each month at 06:00 and by button. No PDF or invoice reads.

point.title: Your home consumption point number
point.description: Enter the home POD number shown in Mój TAURON. It is stored only in HA. The GET requests one explicit point and the response must match it. No PDF.

error.interactive_login: The portal requires an interactive login step (for example MFA).
error.portal_history: History or the selected consumption point was not recognized. Previously confirmed data is retained.
error.invalid_point: Enter a valid consumption point number.
